lyrics:
[00:00.00] 作词 : Jason Mraz
[00:01.00] 作曲 : Jason Mraz
[00:02.00] 制作人 : Martin Terefe
[00:12.48]Well you done done me and you bet I felt it
[00:16.03]I tried to be chill but you're so hot that I melted
[00:19.40]I fell right through the cracks
[00:21.92]now I'm trying to get back
[00:24.92]Before the cool done run out
[00:26.96]I'll be giving it my bestest
[00:28.76]Nothing's gonna stop me but divine intervention
[00:31.87]I reckon its again my turn to win some or learn some
[00:38.27]But I won't hesitate no more, no more
[00:45.39]It cannot wait I'm yours
[01:03.94]Well open up your mind and see like me
[01:07.53]Open up your plans and damn you're free
[01:10.61]Look into your heart and you'll find love love love love
[01:16.23]Listen to the music of the moment people dance and sing
[01:20.72]We're just one big family
[01:23.52]And it's our God-forsaken right to be loved love loved love  love
[01:31.82]So I won't hesitate no more no more
[01:39.52]It cannot wait I'm sure
[01:44.63]There's no need to complicate
[01:48.96]Our time is short
[01:52.23]This is our fate I'm yours
[01:57.77]do do do do you but do you do do do
[02:02.00]But do you want to come on
[02:02.87]Scooch on over closer dear
[02:06.24]And i will nibble your ear
[02:22.54]I've been spending way too long checking my tongue in the mirror
[02:26.89]And bending over backwards just to try to see it clearer
[02:30.70]but My breath fogged up the glass
[02:32.75]And so I drew a new face and I laughed
[02:36.71]I guess what I'll be saying is there ain't no better reason
[02:39.87]To rid yourself of vanities and just go with the seasons
[02:43.20]It's what we aim to do
[02:45.58]Our name is our virtue
[02:49.29]But I won't hesitate no more no more
[02:56.39]It cannot wait I'm yours
[03:02.67]Open up your mind and see like me (I won't hesitate)
[03:05.82]Open up your plans and damn you're free (No more, no more)
[03:08.98]Look into your heart and you'll find the sky is yours (It cannot wait, I'm sure)
[03:14.51]So please don't, please don't please don't (There's no need to complicate)
[03:17.20]There's no need to complicate (Our time is short)
[03:20.12]Coz our time is short (This is our fate)
[03:22.58]This is this is this is our fate
[03:25.12]I'm yours

title: I'm Yours
